notes.title: Update patch 1.0.3 🛠️
notes.content: [p]Thank you to all the players for supporting us![/p][p][/p][p]We have fixed the following details:[/p][list][*][p]Corrected Thai spelling errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the link to our support page[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed skipping the [i]Normal End[/i] and [i]True End[/i] scenes using the Start button on a gamepad[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where the character could turn left/right with a gamepad while the game was paused[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the [i]Bad End[/i] achievement so it now triggers from the start of the Mira & Sophia scene[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
